app_name.description: Title shown in the header, 2-4 words.

summary.description: One paragraph: what the app does for its user.

noun.description: The record's singular noun, lowercase, e.g. 'book'.

options.description: select only: the fixed choices, Title Case; [] otherwise

integer.description: number only: true when only whole numbers make sense (a count), false for a rating, price or measurement

in_form.description: false when only an action sets this value (a borrower, an owner)

message.description: validation message when required/invalid, e.g. 'Title is required.'; '' if not required

title_field.description: field name shown as each row's title

name.description: camelCase identifier, different from every field name

label.description: Visible label in the row, Title Case

rule.description: plain-English computation over field names, e.g. 'days between Start and End', 'Quantity times Price', 'days until Due'

derived.description: values computed from other fields; [] when none

comment.description: one line: the vague phrase in the idea and the value chosen

field.description: kind=field: the select field to narrow by; '' for state

label.description: kind=state: the filter chip text; kind=field: the 'all' chip text, e.g. 'All kinds'

rule.description: kind=state: plain-English predicate over field names, e.g. 'borrower is not empty'; '' for field

empty_text.description: kind=state: shown when nothing matches; '' for field

text.description: what the user reads, with {fieldName} placeholders, e.g. 'Borrowed by {borrower}'

rule.description: 'count of all rows' | 'count of rows where <predicate>' | 'sum of <field>'

unit.description: the unit the figure is read in, e.g. '£'; '' when it is a plain count

emphasis.description: true for the one headline figure the idea asks for

effect.description: plain-English field changes, e.g. 'set borrower to the input', 'clear borrower', 'decrease quantity by 1'; describe the field change only -- never mention a prompt, dialog or popup

input_label.description: label of the one value the user types; '' when none

confirm_text.description: warning to confirm before an irreversible action; '' when none

title.description: vitest title, lowercase verb phrase, e.g. 'adds a book and shows it in the list'

steps.description: the user actions, using field labels, option values and action labels verbatim

expect.description: what the user sees afterwards, verbatim visible text where possible

assumptions.description: each ambiguity and the decision made, one sentence each

message.content:
{
  "app_name": "Home Library",
  "tagline": "Track books on your shelves and who has them.",
  "summary": "A single list of books with fields for title, author, and category. Lend a book by setting a borrower; clear the borrower when it comes back. Filter to see what is out and how many are lent.",
  "noun": "book",
  "noun_plural": "books",
  "fields": [
    {
      "name": "Title",
      "label": "Title",
      "kind": "text",
      "required": true,
      "options": [],
      "integer": false,
      "unit": "",
      "in_form": true,
      "message": "Title is required"
    },
    {
      "name": "Author",
      "label": "Author",
      "kind": "text",
      "required": true,
      "options": [],
      "integer": false,
      "unit": "",
      "in_form": true,
      "message": "Author is required"
    },
    {
      "name": "Category",
      "label": "Category",
      "kind": "select",
      "required": true,
      "options": ["Novel", "Cookbook", "Reference"],
      "integer": false,
      "unit": "",
      "in_form": true,
      "message": "Category is required"
    },
    {
      "name": "Borrower",
      "label": "Borrower",
      "kind": "text",
      "required": false,
      "options": [],
      "integer": false,
      "unit": "",
      "in_form": false,
      "message": ""
    }
  ],
  "title_field": "Title",
  "subtitle_fields": ["Author", "Category"],
  "meta_fields": ["Borrower"],
  "derived": [],
  "constants": [],
  "filters": [
    {
      "kind": "state",
      "field": "Borrower",
      "id": "lent-out",
      "label": "Lent out",
      "rule": "Borrower is not empty"
   ,
      "empty_text": "No books are lent out"
    },
    {
      "kind": "state",
      "field": "Borrower",
      "id": "at-home",
      "label": "At home",
      "rule": "Borrower is empty"
    ,
      "empty_text": "No books are at home"
    }
  ],
  "badges": [
    {
      "id": "lent-to",
      "rule": "Borrower is not empty",
      "tone": "info",
      "text": "Lent to {Borrower}"
    }
  ],
  "stats": [
    {
      "id": "lent-out-count",
      "label": "Lent out",
      "rule": "count of rows where Borrower is not empty",
      "unit": ""
   ,
      "emphasis": true
    }
  ],
  "actions": [
    {
      "id": "lend",
      "label": "Lend",
      "scope": "row",
      "available_rule": "Borrower is empty",
      "effect": "set Borrower to the input"
    ,
      "input_label": "Borrower name",
      "input_required": true
    ,
      "confirm_text": ""
    ,
      "toast": "Book lent"
    },
    {
      "id": "return",
      "label": "Return",
      "scope": "row",
      "available_rule": "Borrower is not empty",
      "effect": "set Borrower to empty"
    ,
      "input_label": "",
      "input_required": false
    ,
      "confirm_text": ""
    ,
      "toast": "Book returned"
    }
  ],
  "journeys": [
    {
      "title": "add a book and see it in the list",
      "kind": "explicit",
      "steps": "Open the app; the list is empty. Click Add. Enter Title, Author, choose Category. Save.",
      "expect": "The book appears in the list. The Lent out stat shows 0."
    },
    {
      "title": "reject an empty required field",
      "kind": "explicit",
      "steps": "Click Add. Leave Title empty. Enter Author, choose Category. Save.",
      "expect": "The form shows 'Title is required' and does not save."
    },
    {
      "title": "edit an existing book",
      "kind": "explicit",
      "steps": "Pick a book in the list. Click Edit. Change Title. Save.",
      "expect": "The list shows the updated Title."
    },
    {
      "title": "delete a book added by mistake",
      "kind": "explicit",
      "steps": "Pick a book in the list. Click Delete. Confirm.",
      "expect": "The book is removed from the list."
    },
    {
      "title": "lend a book and show the borrower",
      "kind": "explicit",
      "steps": "Pick a book with no Borrower. Click Lend. Enter a name. Save.",
      "expect": "The book shows the badge 'Lent to {Borrower}'. The Lent out stat increases by 1."
    },
    {
      "title": "return a book and clear the borrower",
      "kind": "explicit",
      "steps": "Pick a book that is lent out. Click Return.",
      "expect": "The 'Lent to {Borrower}' badge disappears. The Lent out stat decreases by 1."
    },
    {
      "title": "filter to see only books that are lent out",
      "kind": "explicit",
      "steps": "With some books lent out, click the 'Lent out' filter.",
      "expect": "The list shows only books where Borrower is not empty. Each shows the 'Lent to {Borrower}' badge."
    },
    {
      "title": "filter to see only books that are at home",
      "kind": "explicit",
      "steps": "Click the 'At home' filter.",
      "expect": "The list shows only books where Borrower is empty. No 'Lent to' badges appear."
    },
    {
      "title": "see how many books are lent out right now",
      "kind": "explicit",
      "steps": "Look at the stats area.",
      "expect": "The 'Lent out' stat shows the count of rows where Borrower is not empty."
    },
    {
      "title": "persist data across a browser refresh",
      "kind": "explicit",
      "steps": "Add or lend several books. Refresh the browser.",
      "expect": "All books, borrowers, and the Lent out stat are unchanged."
    }
  ],
  "omitted_patterns": [
    {
      "pattern": "due dates or overdue tracking",
      "reason": "The idea does not mention when books are due back."
    },
    {
      "pattern": "multiple copies or quantities per title",
      "reason": "The idea treats each book as a single item."
    },
    {
      "pattern": "user accounts or sharing",
      "reason": "The idea states it is just one person on their own computer."
    },
    {
      "pattern": "search by title or author",
      "reason": "The idea asks for a list and a lent-out filter but not text search."
    },
    {
      "pattern": "shelf location or cover images",
      "reason": "The idea does not mention where a book sits or what it looks like."
    }
  ]
  ,
  "assumptions": [
    "The category select uses the three kinds the user named: Novel, Cookbook, Reference.",
    "A book with no Borrower is considered at home; a book with a Borrower is lent out.",
    "The headline stat is the count of books currently lent out."
  ]
}
